name: BangSquash PRO
summary:
BangSquash is a block breaker-style for Oculus virtual reality (VR) platform which could be attractive for people of all ages. We believe Bang Squash to be an ideal game to show off the basic operation of the Oculus platform to novice players, or to get in a mini workout session in a couple of minutes.
